units.composition: mole fraction of oxide formula units
units.activity: dimensionless, relative to the declared pure-liquid P2O5 standard

jung_hudon_liquid_1bar.source_gas_standard_pressure: 1 atm, inferred from the assessment convention
jung_hudon_liquid_1bar.pressure_correction_equation: G_1bar = G_1atm - delta_n_gas * R * T * ln(1.01325)

derivation.premise: Suito and Inoue report Eq. 14 as a no-Mn P2O5 activity-coefficient relation on the earlier Turkdogan-Pearson hypothetical-liquid standard. Their coefficient of x_P2O5 was obtained by combining prior low-P data with their 4-5 wt% measurements.
derivation.units_check: Mole fractions and gamma are dimensionless; 22990/T is dimensionless with 22990 in kelvin; each Gibbs coefficient evaluates to J mol^-1 P2O5; R*T is J mol^-1.

turkdogan_2000_eq13.derivation: Comparison only; add log10(x_P2O5) and convert from the old 1-atm liquid standard before comparing with the central result.

turkdogan_2000_eq25.derivation: Comparison only; add log10(x_P2O5) and convert from the revised 1-atm liquid standard before comparing with the central result.

suito-inoue-1984.citation: Suito, H. and Inoue, R. (1984), Phosphorus Distribution between MgO-saturated CaO-FetO-SiO2-P2O5-MnO Slags and Liquid Iron, Transactions of the Iron and Steel Institute of Japan 24(1), 40-46.
suito-inoue-1984.locator: p. 45, Section IV.2, Eq. 14 (no-Mn form); pp. 45-46, Section IV.2, separate MnO coefficient 13 +/- 9. The synopsis on p. 40 gives the 1550-1650 C experiment range and slag systems.

suito-inoue-1981-low-p.citation: Suito, H., Inoue, R. and Takada, M. (1981), Phosphorus Distribution between Liquid Iron and MgO Saturated Slags of the System CaO-MgO-FeOx-SiO2, Transactions of the Iron and Steel Institute of Japan 21(4), 250-259.
suito-inoue-1981-low-p.locator: Prior low-P dataset used in Suito and Inoue (1984), p. 45, Section IV.2; Turkdogan (2000), Table 1, p. 965 reports its P2O5 interval as 0.2-1.0 wt%.

turkdogan-2000-old-standard.citation: Turkdogan, E. T. (2000), Assessment of P2O5 Activity Coefficients in Molten Slags, ISIJ International 40(10), 964-970.
turkdogan-2000-old-standard.locator: p. 964, Eq. 4: earlier approximate hypothetical-liquid P2O5 standard, Delta G degree = -1534480 + 506.26*T J mol^-1.

turkdogan-2000-eq13.citation: Turkdogan, E. T. (2000), Assessment of P2O5 Activity Coefficients in Molten Slags, ISIJ International 40(10), 964-970.
turkdogan-2000-eq13.locator: p. 965, Eq. 13; BO = wt% CaO + 0.33 wt% MgO; the intercept is reported as -11.85 +/- 0.75.

turkdogan-2000-revised-standard.citation: Turkdogan, E. T. (2000), Assessment of P2O5 Activity Coefficients in Molten Slags, ISIJ International 40(10), 964-970.
turkdogan-2000-revised-standard.locator: p. 966, Eq. 23: revised estimated hypothetical-liquid P2O5 standard, Delta G degree = -1655480 + 571.0*T J mol^-1.

turkdogan-2000-eq25.citation: Turkdogan, E. T. (2000), Assessment of P2O5 Activity Coefficients in Molten Slags, ISIJ International 40(10), 964-970.
turkdogan-2000-eq25.locator: p. 967, Eq. 25; BO = wt% CaO + 0.33 wt% MgO.

jung-hudon-p2o5.citation: Jung, I.-H. and Hudon, P. (2012), Thermodynamic Assessment of P2O5, Journal of the American Ceramic Society 95(11), 3665-3672; equation reproduced in Jung et al. (2013), Thermodynamic Database of P2O5-containing Oxide Systems for the Dephosphorization Process in Steelmaking, High Temperature Materials and Processes 32(3), 247-254.
jung-hudon-p2o5.locator: Jung et al. (2013), Eq. 3: P2(g) + 5/2 O2(g) = P2O5(l), Delta G degree = -1616372 + 539.0*T J mol^-1; assessment does not quantify numeric uncertainty.
